cards.question:
Lower bound insertion semantics

`lower_bound(x)` is the insertion point _______ all existing elements _______
cards.answer:
before all existing elements `>= x`

(Insertion point before any existing `x`)

cards.question:
Upper bound insertion semantics

`upper_bound(x)` is the insertion point _______ all existing elements _______
cards.answer:
after all existing elements `<= x`

(Insertion point after any existing `x`)

cards.question:
First/last occurrence

- First occurrence of `x`: _______
- Last occurrence of `x`: _______
cards.answer:
- First occurrence: `lower_bound(x)`
- Last occurrence: `upper_bound(x) - 1`

Comment: subject to bounds checking and validation.

cards.question: Open interval containing all occurrences of `x`

Count of `x`

The number of occurrences of `x` in terms of upper and lower bound

Existence in terms of bounds

If `lower = lower_bound(x)` and `upper = upper_bound(x)`, state conditions for existence of `x` in an array:

- In terms of `lower`
- In terms of `upper`
- Relationship of `lower` and `upper`
cards.answer:
`x` exists in an array if:

- `lower < n` and `arr[lower] == x`
- `upper > 0` and `arr[upper - 1] == x`
- `lower < upper` (`x` is absent if `lower == upper`)

cards.question:
Predecessor/successor

- Predecessor of `x`:
- Successor of `x`:
cards.answer:
- Predecessor of `x`: `lower_bound(x) - 1`
- Successor of `x`: `upper_bound(x)`

Comment: both answer subject to bounds checking.
